description: Source code for the DynamicSection class handling ELF dynamic sections, including initialization, symbol lookup, and constructor/destructor calls.

classes.name: DynamicSection
classes.description: Class managing ELF dynamic section parsing, symbol resolution, and constructor/destructor invocation.

methods.name: DynamicSection
methods.description: Constructor initializing the dynamic section with base address, dynamic entries, count, and flags.

methods.name: InitDynamicSection
methods.description: Initializes the dynamic section by parsing dynamic tags and setting up relevant pointers and flags.

methods.name: GetDynamicTable
methods.description: Returns the pointer to the dynamic table.

methods.name: GetDynamicTableSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the dynamic table.

methods.name: CallFunction
methods.description: Invokes a function pointer if it is valid (non-zero, not -1).

methods.name: LookupById
methods.description: Retrieves symbol information by index from the symbol table.

methods.name: IsWeakById
methods.description: Checks if a symbol by index is weakly bound.

methods.name: LookupNameById
methods.description: Gets the symbol name by index.

methods.name: LookupByName
methods.description: Finds a symbol by its name using hash tables.
